design.input: A young Japanese voice actress performing an energetic boy hero in an anime: gender-neutral and boyish, bright, slightly husky, youthful and warm, with clear standard Japanese diction.
A young voice actress performing an energetic boy hero in an English anime dub: gender-neutral and boyish, bright, slightly husky, youthful and warm, with clear American English diction.

lines.text: ある夜、町から文字が消えた。
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: One night, every letter vanished from the town.
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: 文字を食べるかげ……モジクイのしわざだ。
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: The work of the Mojikui — a shadow that eats words.
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: ぼくの名前も、食べられました……！
lines.style: cheerful, earnest young hero

lines.text: It even ate my name...!
lines.style: cheerful, earnest young hero

lines.text: でも、あなたには「書く手」がある。
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: But you have a hand that writes.
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: 書いた漢字が光になって、町の看板がよみがえる！
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: Every kanji you write turns into light — and the town's signs come back to life!
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: たたかいは手本なしの真剣勝負。正しく書くほど、こうげきが強くなる！

lines.text: In battle, you write from memory. The better you write, the harder you hit!
lines.style: bright, exciting and warm, like the narrator of an anime game trailer

lines.text: あなたは書きます。ぼくはたたかいます！

lines.text: You write. I fight!
